text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Sonnet, the officer, claimed on night one to have seen Luna and Terra as killers, and on day two named both publicly. Haiku, the doctor, backed Sonnet and pushed hard on Luna, but the town's big early mistake came on day one, when Haiku and Terra voted out Gemma, a citizen who had dodged questions and defended Luna. The turning point came on day two, when the town voted out Luna, who flipped as a killer and made Sonnet's claim look right. Terra was voted out on day three, and the town won with Sonnet and Haiku, while Sol died on night two after voting for Terra.
